name: Special City Council - 4:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council - 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 13, 2018 -
4:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Third Amendment to the Agreement for Cooperative Fire Management Services by and between the City of Del Mar, City of Encinitas, and City of Solana Beach. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
1) Approve the Third Amendment to the Agreement for Cooperative Fire Management Services by and between the City of Del Mar, City of Encinitas, and the City of Solana Beach in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 in consultation with the City Attorney; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2018-06-13 Special Meeting Item 01 Third Amendment to Agreement for Cooperative FMS Agreement
2.
Introduction of City Manager's Proposed Fiscal Year 2018-2019 Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Review proposed FY 2018-2019 operating and capital budgets; 2) Receive public input; and 3) Provide direction to staff regarding revisions to the proposed FY 2018-2019 operating and capital budgets for final consideration and adoption on June 20, 2018.
2018-06-13 Special Meeting Item 02 Intro of Proposed FY 2018-19 Budget
a.
Report on the Pilot FY 2017-18 Porta Potty/Handwashing Station Program. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Receive and file the report or provide additional direction to staff.
2018-06-13 Special Meeting Item 02a Porta Potties
b.
Funding Recommendations for Artistic Elements for Interchanges at Santa Fe Drive and Encinitas Boulevard in the proposed FY 2018-2019 budget.
Approve the funding recommendation of the City Council Subcommittee for artistic elements on the redesigned interchanges on Interstate 5 at Santa Fe Drive and Encinitas Boulevard.
2018-06-13 Special Meeting Item 02b Interchanges Artistic Elements Funding
c.
Agreement for downtown sidewalk cleaning services. Contact Person: Director of Public Works Quiram.
1) City Council authorize the City Manager or her designee, in conjunction with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement for Sidewalk Cleaning Services with Pacific Sweeping for an initial (3) three-year term, and authorize the City Manager or designee to extend the agreement for up to two (2) two-year renewal options for a total contract term not exceeding seven years. The agreement and renewal options are not to exceed the annual budgeted amount; and 2) City Council authorize additional budget, in FY18/19, in the amount of $118,193 for a total contract amount of $180,393, to be added to Account 10171630 432.2 to pay for the increased level of cleaning to the sidewalks and benches in downtown Old Encinitas.
2018-06-13 Special Meeting Item 02c Award Downtown Sidewalk Cleaning
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
